summary: Retested the iteration_76 minor fixes. All pass. Backend (new pytest file, 2/2): (a) With the org set to expired and a past next_run_at, the scheduler created no run in 72s; the schedule went to mode 'off' with next_run_at null. (b) Lock heartbeat: during a 4-connection manual run, locked_until was refreshed 4 times (a new value per connection) and was null after the run. (c) In realtime mode, run-now pushed next_run_at about 15 min ahead. Frontend: (1) Connected integrations shows 'just now' right after Sync now, with no 'in 0 min'. (2) Off mode (expired) shows the toggle unchecked and disabled, no save button, and 'Automatic sync is off'. (3) Realtime has no sync-save-btn. Turning the toggle off saves at once (toast 'Sync schedule saved', line shows 'Automatic sync is off', toggle unchecked); turning it back on restores 'Next sync … (in 15 min)'. (4) Weekly mode with saved tz UTC and a spoofed browser tz America/New_York: sync-tz-prefill-note shows and Save is enabled; after saving, the note goes away and Save is disabled again. (5) See plans goes to /choose-plan (seen in daily mode). (6) With GET /api/sync/settings aborted via route, sync-load-error and sync-retry-btn show; Retry recovers after unroute. The testpro org was restored to enterprise_monthly with schedule enabled=true, Mon 07:00 Europe/London.

issues: The plan hint in Off mode ('Automatic sync needs an active plan…') has no 'See plans' link, because the code renders it only when mode !== 'off'. Off is the mode where an upgrade link matters most. Optional.

action_items: (optional) Show the 'See plans' link in Off mode too
critical_code_review_comments: process_sync_schedules_once now re-checks the plan with _schedule() before _claim, and the next_run_at equality check stops stale slots. Correct.
Realtime manual runs reschedule in _execute (reschedule or mode == 'realtime'). Correct.
seed_data_creation: Added a few manual sync_runs to testpro's org. The org tier and schedule were restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_sync_schedule_iter77.py takes about 77s (real scheduler wait). It flips the org_15337f4cefc9 tier through Mongo and restores enterprise_monthly in teardown. You can simulate the browser tz by overriding Intl.DateTimeFormat.prototype.resolvedOptions through add_init_script.
